title: Engenheiro de Orçamentos
description:
Descrição das Responsabilidades:

  1. Propor melhor desempenho técnico e financeiro dos projetos a serem empreendidos atendendo aos padrões de clientes, bem como às estratégias, aos padrões e à qualidade da empresa;
  2. Realizar a análise de editais para elaboração do orçamento das propostas técnico comerciais, atendendo aos padrões de clientes, bem como às estratégias, aos padrões e à qualidade da empresa;
  3. Planejar e efetuar estudo de viabilidade dos projetos, composição de preços e execução de proposta técnica e comercial para as licitações;
  4. Realizar análise econômica, verificando o mercado e a saúde financeira da empresa durante a execução de projetos;
  5. Efetuar a estimativa de gastos, analisando a expectativa de custo dos projetos de acordo com os padrões definidos pelos clientes;
  6. Manter o controle das mudanças que devem ser feitas durante um projeto e calcular o seu impacto econômico;
  7. Realizar a análise de riscos financeiros de cada etapa dos projetos;
  8. Realizar o levantamento quantitativo, contemplando todos os cálculos das quantidades de materiais para o projeto da obra e seus valores;
  9. Elaborar planilhas orçamentárias completas e a documentação que deve ser repassada para a equipe de engenharia;
  10. Elaborar orçamento para propostas de execução dos projetos das obras;
  11. Analisar os projetos, sob o ponto de vista de custos, planejamento, engenharia e adequação destas análises à estratégia do projeto visando garantir o menor custo versus rentabilidade versus competitividade da proposta;
  12. Realizar a equalização das propostas técnicas;
  13. Elaborar relatórios dos orçamentos realizados mensalmente.

Outros requisitos:

Escolaridade: Superior completo em Engenharia Civil.

Conhecimentos Imprescindíveis: Elaboração de preços e planilhas orçamentárias. Pacote Office.

Conhecimentos Desejáveis: Sistema TOTVS RM, especialização em cursos voltados à orçamentos.

Certificações Exigidas: Registro no CREA.

Certificações Desejáveis: MBA ou pós-graduação em áreas afins.

Há 30 anos a FBS constrói novos caminhos, atuando em projetos de Engenharia e Infraestrutura para criar soluções e construções inovadoras para a evolução nacional. Estamos em constante renovação para unir modernidade, know-how e um controle rigoroso de qualidade. Para seguir nos aprimorando, buscamos um profissional que esteja sempre projetando o futuro, com responsabilidade, transparência e garra para nos manter em crescimento, oferecendo o melhor para nossos clientes com versatilidade e agilidade.

title: Analista de Planejamento Financeiro Pleno / Hospital Care
description:
Job description

Em 2017, fundamos a Hospital Care com o objetivo claro de transformar o cenário da saúde suplementar no Brasil.

Nosso foco é estabelecer redes abrangentes de serviços de saúde, começando pela aquisição de hospitais privados de alta complexidade e expandindo de maneira orgânica. Essas redes, que chamamos de “Hubs”, conectam-se a diversos ativos, formando um ecossistema completo de serviços de saúde, desde laboratórios de exames, planos de saúde e centros médicos, até hospitais de alta complexidade.

Buscamos, através desta união, tornar o sistema justo para todos os envolvidos, oferecendo aos pacientes tratamentos focados no seu bem-estar, para as operadoras de saúde valores justos e sem desperdícios, aos colaboradores reconhecimento digno e aos investidores retornos sustentáveis, favorecendo toda a cadeia por meio de gestão otimizada e eficiente.

Atuamos para melhorar o acesso à saúde como um todo, e nossas ações são orientadas para sermos a melhor rede de saúde privada do Brasil, além de fortalecer o sistema de saúde brasileiro, promovendo o equilíbrio de interesses entre pacientes, médicos, fontes pagadoras, parceiros e acionistas.

Atualmente, contamos com 6 Hubs operacionais nas regiões Sul e Sudeste, compondo uma rede com 9 hospitais, mais de 1.479 leitos, 8.000 colaboradores e 13 mil médicos associados, além de duas operadoras de saúde.

Main responsibilities

  • Processar o fechamento de resultados contábeis mensais.
  • Realizar reclassificações contábeis.
  • Criar pivôs gerenciais de análise.
  • Acompanhar mensalmente o orçamento.
  • Elaborar forecast mensal e anual.
  • Analisar o resultado da companhia.
  • Auxiliar na elaboração do orçamento anual.
  • Contribuir com análises de causas e planos de ação para resolução de problemas.
  • Manter dados que sustentem indicadores para análises das equipes.
  • Criar materiais de reports gerenciais e realizar reuniões de acompanhamento mensal com setores (Excel e/ou PowerPoint).
  • Garantir a integridade e a consistência dos dados utilizados em relatórios e BI.

Requirements and skills

  • Graduação em Ciências Contábeis, Administração ou Economia.
  • Experiência anterior na função.
  • Conhecimento avançado em Excel e PowerPoint.
  • Desejável conhecimento no sistema SAP.
  • Disponibilidade para atuar no modelo híbrido.
  • Residir em Campinas ou região.

Additional information

A Hospital Care zela por sua qualidade de vida, por isso temos um cuidado especial com vocês:

title: Senior RPA Developer
description:
About Nubank

Nubank was founded in 2013 to free people from a bureaucratic, slow, and inefficient financial system. Since then, through innovative technology and outstanding customer service, the company has been redefining people's relationships with money across Latin America. With operations in Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia, Nubank is today one of the largest digital banking platforms and technology-leading companies in the world.

Today, Nubank is a global company, with offices in São Paulo (Brazil), Mexico City (Mexico), Buenos Aires (Argentina), Bogotá (Colombia), Durham (United States), and Berlin (Germany). It was founded in 2013 in São Paulo, by Colombian David Vélez, and co founded by Brazilian Cristina Junqueira and American Edward Wible. For more information, visit .

About the team

The Talent Acquisition Operations (TA Ops) team enables Nubank’s Talent Acquisition function to scale with consistency, speed, and quality. We operate and evolve the core systems and processes that support hiring while designing solutions that support recruiters, hiring managers, and candidates throughout their journeys. With a strong focus on automation, data quality, and user experience, we work to reduce manual effort and enhance decision-making across the board.

In this role, you’ll also be embedded in Nubank’s Business Automation hub – a central team focused on helping functions across the company become more efficient and scalable. There, you’ll collaborate with technical peers to align on architecture, implementation, and standards, ensuring consistency in what we deliver and supporting your ongoing technical development.

You will be responsible for
  • Process Analysis and Optimization: Collaborate closely with stakeholders within Talent Acquisition to thoroughly analyze existing business processes. Identify and prioritize opportunities for automation, focusing on areas that can benefit from increased efficiency, accuracy, and cost reduction.
  • Automation Development and Implementation: Leverage your expertise in UiPath and AI technologies to design, develop, and implement robust and scalable automation solutions. This includes building workflows, configuring bots, and integrating AI capabilities like machine learning and natural language processing to handle complex tasks.
  • Systems Integration: Work with multiple Talent Acquisition systems and tools, including Greenhouse (ATS), GEM (CRM), GoodTime (interview scheduling), custom-built solutions, and broader HR platforms. Design and maintain seamless data flows between systems, ensuring integration supports efficient processes while upholding data integrity and security across all automation workflows.
  • Mentorship and Knowledge Sharing: Act as a mentor and guide to less experienced team members. Share your knowledge and expertise, provide guidance on best practices, and foster a collaborative learning environment within the team.
  • Collaboration and Teamwork: Actively participate in multidisciplinary teams, working closely with business analysts, developers, and other stakeholders to deliver comprehensive automation solutions that align with business goals and objectives.
  • Documentation and Knowledge Management: Maintain clear and comprehensive documentation of developed solutions. This includes creating flow diagrams, technical manuals, user guides, and other relevant documentation to ensure knowledge transfer and ease of maintenance.
  • Innovation and Technology Trend Analysis: Stay abreast of emerging technologies and trends in automation. Proactively identify and evaluate new tools, techniques, and methodologies that can be leveraged to enhance existing automation or develop innovative solutions.
We are looking for a person who

Must-Have:

  • At least 4 years of experience in business process automation using RPA.
  • Proficiency in the UiPath tool, including development in Studio, StudioX, and automation with Orchestrator.
  • Experience with databases, especially with SQL Server, for queries, data extraction, and integration with automation.
  • Experience in creating and optimizing AI prompts using language models like GPT (or similar tools).
  • Solid knowledge of development best practices, such as code versioning, testing, and design patterns applied to automation.

title: IT Asset Recovery Manager
description:
We are Lenovo. We do what we say. We own what we do. We WOW our customers.

Lenovo is a US$57 billion revenue global technology powerhouse, ranked #248 in the Fortune Global 500, and serving millions of customers every day in 180 markets. Focused on a bold vision to deliver Smarter Technology for All, Lenovo has built on its success as the world’s largest PC company with a full-stack portfolio of AI-enabled, AI-ready, and AI-optimized devices (PCs, workstations, smartphones, tablets), infrastructure (server, storage, edge, high performance computing and software defined infrastructure), software, solutions, and services. Lenovo’s continued investment in world-changing innovation is building a more equitable, trustworthy, and smarter future for everyone, everywhere. Lenovo is listed on the Hong Kong stock exchange under Lenovo Group Limited (HKSE: 992) (ADR: LNVGY).

This transformation together with Lenovo’s world-changing innovation is building a more inclusive, trustworthy, and smarter future for everyone, everywhere. To find out more visit and read about the latest news via our StoryHub.

Description and Requirements

The IT Asset Recovery Manager will work closely with the Lenovo sales team, Project Management Office, and Customer to design a solution for the recovery of the Customers end of life IT products. This position will develop comprehensive, executable, and cost-effective sustainable solutions to enable Lenovo’s Customers to responsibly reuse or recycle their retiring IT products while maximizing the return value of their retiring assets. In addition, this position will also evaluate customer opportunities as presented in RFPs/RFQs or engagements, from the Services and Hardware Sales teams and use this information to develop solutions to meet the customer’s IT asset disposition (ITAD) requirements. This BRAZIL Sustainability Service Designer will be responsible for developing and communicating creative ITAD service solutions for customers to drive positive value-add, return-on-investments, and lower the total cost of ownership of their products.

High Level Tasks

  • Collaborate with internal teams and Lenovo vendors to analyze customer processes and environments and provide value recovery expertise and overall solution recommendations.
  • Translate the Customer requirements into ITAD solutions delivered by Lenovo.
  • Create business case collateral to be leveraged to assist sales to close potential opportunities.
  • Educate customers and internal stakeholders on ITAD services. Engage as a subject matter expert and trusted advisor on ITAD solutions.
  • Challenge existing processes to ensure delivery of the best solution for the customer.
  • Maintain an up-to-date knowledge and understanding of certifications, technology, tools and toolsets in the ITAD industry.

Position Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree required, preferably in Sustainability or Business equivalent.
  • 5+ years’ experience in solution development, contract creation and negotiation, business development, project management and/or services operations experience.
  • Must have experience in project management, product lifecycle management, customer and vendor contracting.
  • Experience with working with Vendors to quote, analyze, negotiate, and document the most cost-effective solution for the Customer.
  • Experience with IT product (laptops, desktops, mobile phones, servers, storage, etc.) end of life management.
  • Proficient with Microsoft applications – Excel, Word, and Powerpoint.
  • Experience with process improvements across multiple regions within an organization.
  • Strong ability to produce, leverage and interpret big data sets and operationalize for decision making.
  • Highly articulate and professional in both oral and written communication, as well as presentation, persuasion, and negotiation skills to achieve desired results.

title: CX Branding Senior Specialist
description:
Why GMF?

GM Financial International Operations conducts business in Latin America and China. International Operations offers a wide range of wholesale and retail automotive financing products to dealers and their customers. The strength of the international business lies in its ability to tailor its products to meet unique dealer needs, consumer preferences and national requirements in local markets. Latin American country operations include Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Mexico, and Peru.

About the role

The Brand Senior Specialist (3F) is responsible for enhancing the brand experience for both internal and external audiences. This involves delivering superior consumer content, maintaining brand identity, and ensuring alignment with GM Financial brands. The specialist optimizes resources, manages budgets, participates in key projects, and collaborates with stakeholders from General Motors and GM Financial globally.

Also, drives a customer-centric approach by developing content for key initiatives and executing high-end internal marketing. A crucial part of their role is integrating the Think Customer mind-set into daily operations through continuous engagement and promoting employee empowerment.

The Senior Specialist must set high standards of performance, maintain effectiveness during major changes, have ability to prioritize work, establish plans of execution, and implement an organized work methodology to ensure proper traceability of tasks. Passion for creating positive impacts for customers is essential.

What you need

  • Educational Background: Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Marketing, Advertising, etc.
  • Performance Standards: Demonstrated ability to set and maintain performance standards across projects, aligning efforts with organizational goals.
  • Project Management: Strong track record in project management, including developing and executing plans that prioritize tasks for timely project completion.
  • Team Leadership: Experience leading multifunctional and/or multicultural teams or individuals without formal authority.
  • Agile Design: Comfort with designing within an agile design lifecycle.
  • Marketing Expertise: Proven experience in marketing, brand implementation, and content creation, with a solid understanding of best practices in internal marketing strategies.
  • Creative Agency Management: Proven experience in managing relationships with creative agencies, overseeing the execution of projects, ensuring alignment with brand guidelines, and optimizing the use of allocated budgets.
  • Global Collaboration: Demonstrated global experience, with the ability to effectively collaborate with teams in different countries and navigate cultural nuances.
  • Visual Aesthetics Expertise: Exceptional eye for design and visual aesthetics, with the ability to create visually compelling content that aligns with brand guidelines and enhances audience engagement.
  • Attention to Detail: Detail-oriented with an expert eye for design and visual aesthetics, ensuring all content aligns with brand guidelines and resonates with the target audience.
  • Content Creation: Proficiency in content creation, including the development of content pillars and copywriting, with the ability to craft compelling narratives that engage and inspire audiences.

What you will be doing

  • Brand Governance: Implement the Global Brand Governance accurately across all markets, ensuring alignment with parent brands and involving key stakeholders from General Motors and GM Financial.
  • Brand Identity Management: Manage and maintain the brand identity, including the development and enforcement of brand guidelines and assets.
  • Content Creation: Develop and execute content that aligns with the brand identity and resonates with the target audience.
  • Content Oversight: Oversee the creation of high-quality, engaging content across multiple platforms in all markets, ensuring consistency and relevance.
  • Agency and Budget Management: Manage relationships with creative and content agencies, ensuring optimal use of the allocated budget.
  • Asset Management: Develop and maintain up-to-date brand experience assets.
  • Action Plan Execution: Ensure the successful execution of defined action plans, monitoring progress, coordinating with relevant teams and stakeholders, and ensuring tasks are completed on time and within budget.
  • Stakeholder Guidance: Provide guidance and support to stakeholders and vendors for the correct implementation of brand and content strategies.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Collaborate with other functional/departmental managers to ensure full visibility of goals, purposes, and achievements, supporting business requirements.
  • Open Communication: Foster an open communication environment that encourages information sharing, values diverse viewpoints, and seeks input from others.
  • Project Management: Develop comprehensive execution plans for service design projects, setting clear activities, expected outcomes, timelines, and milestones to ensure project success.
  • Performance Standards: Establish clear performance standards for service initiatives, ensuring consistency and quality.
  • Internal Initiatives: Drive the strategic creation and implementation of internal initiatives assigned to the area, supporting the positioning of these initiatives.
  • Think Customer Integration: Integrate the Think Customer initiative into daily operations through continuous engagement, training, and promoting employee empowerment.
  • Strategy Monitoring: Monitor and report on the effectiveness of the implemented brand and content strategies, making necessary adjustments for continuous improvement.

What we offer

At GM Financial we want you to be the most authentic version of yourself. We take care of your work-life balance by programming wellness and integration activities, where you will strengthen your relationships with peers and contribute towards the development and wellbeing of your community, while providing you with a competitive salary and benefits.   • Experiência com utilitários Oracle, incluindo OraTOP, Enterprise Manager, SQL Developer e ASH Viewer.

title: Senior Devops Engineer
description:
Join to apply for the Senior Devops Engineer role at Rain

Rain is the fastest-growing earned wage access (EWA) fintech in the U.S., serving 2.5 million employees and backed by top investors like QED and Prosus.

We've raised nearly $400M in funding—including the largest Series A in fintech history—and just closed our Series B to fuel our next stage of hypergrowth.

We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated DevOps Engineer to join our innovative and fast-paced team.

This role offers the opportunity to design, deploy, and manage scalable, cloud-native infrastructure to support modern applications.

As a DevOps Engineer, you will work with cutting-edge tools and technologies, ensuring seamless integration and deployment for our microservices architecture. If you thrive in environments focused on automation, scalability, and observability, this is the perfect role for you!

Key Responsibilities:

  1. Infrastructure Automation: Design and implement infrastructure as code (IaC) using Terraform and Terragrunt. Automate provisioning and deployment of AWS resources to ensure high availability and scalability.
  2. Microservices Deployment: Build and manage containerized applications using Kubernetes with Helm for package management. Support and enhance microservices developed in Go (Golang).
  3. CI/CD Pipelines: Develop and maintain robust pipelines in GitLab CI/CD to enable seamless build, test, and deployment workflows. Optimize pipelines for performance, reliability, and security.
  4. Monitoring and Observability: Set up and maintain observability stacks using tools like Grafana, Prometheus, and Datadog. Monitor system health and performance, proactively identifying and resolving bottlenecks.
  5. Collaboration and Support: Collaborate with development and QA teams to ensure efficient application lifecycle management. Document processes, workflows, and playbooks for effective knowledge sharing.

Required Skills and Experience:

  1. Proven experience with Kubernetes in production environments, including deploying and scaling applications.
  2. Strong expertise in Terraform and Terragrunt for IaC.
  3. Hands-on experience with GitLab CI/CD for building and managing pipelines.
  4. Deep understanding of cloud infrastructure, preferably AWS.
  5. Experience with monitoring and observability tools like Grafana, Prometheus, and Datadog.
  6. Familiarity with configuration management tools (e.g., Helm) and secure application deployment practices.
  7. Public Cloud provider certifications in AWS & or Kubernetes (nice-to-have).

Nice-to-Have Skills:

  1. Experience with SRE practices and incident management workflows.
  2. Proficiency in developing and deploying microservices, especially with Go (Golang).
  3. Familiarity with multi-environment infrastructure setups and best practices.
  4. Knowledge of database systems like PostgreSQL.
  5. Experience with load balancing and auto-scaling in cloud-native environments.

title: Internal Auditor
description:
Career Opportunities: Internal Auditor (17611)

World leader on its markets, Vallourec provides benchmark tubular solutions for the energy sector and other highly demanding applications: from oil and gas wells in extreme conditions to state-of-the-art power plants, including bold architectural projects and high-performance mechanical equipment.

In figures, Vallourec is a French industrial group listed on the SBF120 with 16,000 employees and a turnover of 5 billion euros. With a presence in 20 countries, the group operates on all continents.

Vallourec also encompasses 40 production units, 380 researchers and technicians, 4 research and testing centers, and over 45 million euros invested in R&D.

Finally, drawing on its experience in the Oil & Gas sector, Vallourec is preparing for the future by currently developing a comprehensive portfolio of products and solutions that meet the needs of energy transition: carbon capture, hydrogen storage, geothermal energy.

This context makes the environment particularly dynamic and international.

Main missions and activities:

  • Assess the application of procedures and processes by entities, corporate departments and Shared Services Centers throughout the Group.
  • Carry out audit missions (periodic audits or investigation).
  • Prepare recommendations for findings in a report dispatched to the Group managers.

Reporting to the Internal Audit Director, the internal auditor is in charge of:

Periodic audits

  • Preparing and carrying out periodic audits in line with Group methodology.
  • Leading the preparatory phase of the audit to ensure maximum efficiency and to obtain a global understanding of the organization's entity, key events and main areas of risks.

This involves:

  • Preparing audit notifications schedules and agendas.
  • Overseeing the operational phase of the audit: acting as the entity's point of contact.
  • Coordinating data collection (financial data, business review, risk analysis, audit reports,...).
  • Conducting interviews with key managers and all persons involved.
  • Defining audit scope and objectives.
  • Carrying out and supervising tests based on work standards and procedures.
  • Finalizing audit findings and prioritizing recommendations.
  • Monitoring the progress of action plans resulting from the audits carried out, with reference to the timetable established with the entities.
  • Promoting the sharing of best practices between Group entities.
  • Sending a report to the internal control director after the final meeting (report which will then be sent to the entity and to the Vallourec senior managers).

Investigations

The internal auditor could participate in fraud detection and resolution:

  • Prepare and carry out investigations if needed with the internal control director.
  • Propose a relevant methodology and work plan to address specific risks.
  • Coordinate with external support (if any).
  • Write ad hoc reports with recommendations (action plans).

In support of the Director of Internal Audit, the senior internal auditor will also be involved in:

  • Building the annual audit plan.
  • Improving audit methodology (review of work program and best practices).

Notes:

  • Many travels abroad, including long distances needed (USA, Brazil, China, Dubaï...).
  • Corporate position with diversified contacts throughout the Group, worldwide, at all levels (with senior management as well as in mills or with shared service centers).
  • Demonstrate ability to communicate and coordinate with all VLR departments involved. Particularly, ability to write reports mentioning recommendations and being objective.

Requirements:

Experience:

  • Previous experience of internal audit.
  • International experiences (at least as a long term trainee or as a student).

Skills: Autonomy, rigor, dynamic and “agile” mindset, communication skills.

title: Operador(a) de Caixa
description:
Porque trabalhar conosco:

O grupo Savegnago está em constante crescimento e evolução, sempre com respeito pelas pessoas e suas singularidades!

Junte-se ao nosso time de profissionais que compartilham o propósito de gerar valor as pessoas.

Essa é uma oportunidade para integrar nosso Banco de Talentos, abrangendo diversos setores dos nossos supermercados e Centro Administrativo. Seus dados serão mantidos em nosso sistema, permitindo que você seja considerado para futuros processos seletivos alinhados ao seu perfil.

Cadastre seu perfil e construa sua Carreira no Savegnago.

Sobre a vaga:

A Pessoa Operadora de Caixa desempenha um papel crucial na experiência do cliente e na eficiência financeira da empresa. Suas principais responsabilidades incluem registrar compras, calcular valores, receber pagamentos em dinheiro, cartões ou outros meios, emitir recibos e fornecer troco, se necessário. São encarregados também de manter a precisão nas transações, resolver problemas de pagamento e garantir um excelente atendimento ao cliente.

O quer você irá entregar:

  • Registrar (scanear) corretamente as mercadorias e observar os produtos a fim de evitar registrar a mesma marca com variações diferentes;
  • Receber valores de acordo com a forma de pagamento dentro dos procedimentos validados pela empresa, conferir e efetuar troco, quando necessário;
  • Emitir e entregar cupom fiscal ao cliente;
  • Confirmar e informar o valor e as condições de pagamento ao cliente;
  • Auxiliar no empacotamento dos produtos quando necessário;
  • Solicitar a apresentação de documento de identificação do cliente, de acordo com a forma de pagamento (normas e procedimentos da empresa);
  • Informar, orientar e direcionar o cliente quando o mesmo solicitar informações;
  • Divulgar promoções e descontos;
  • Efetuar fechamento do movimento do caixa junto a tesouraria;
  • Manusear as mercadorias com cuidado evitando quebras/perdas;
  • Observar com atenção os carrinhos de compra se todos os produtos foram registrados;
  • Observar movimentação de clientes principalmente no momento de fechamento e/ ou recolhimento monetário dos caixas;
  • Entender o funcionamento dos demais setores da empresa podendo orientar aos clientes quando questionado;
  • Conferir cheques recebidos, verificar autenticidade das cédulas recebidas, organizando em gaveta apropriada;
  • Informar tesoureira/fiscal de caixa a necessidade de sangria de valores quando atingir valor pré-estabelecido pela empresa;
  • Verificar condições de limpeza e abastecimento dos artigos expostos no check-out;
  • Participar do inventário, quando convocado;
  • Executar corretamente o procedimento de entrega anotando com atenção os dados referentes ao endereço, numeração de caixas e lacres.

Estamos em busca de pessoas que possuam:

  • Ensino médio completo.

Onde você irá trabalhar:

Savegnago Supermercado - São Carlos/SP.

Nossa jornada de trabalho:

Disponibilidade para atuar em escala 6x1, incluindo finais de semana e feriados.

description:
O Auxiliar de Limpeza é o profissional responsável por auxiliar na limpeza e conservação do local e ambiente. Um Auxiliar de Limpeza é responsável pela manutenção do local com foco em mantê-lo limpo.

Está sob as responsabilidades de um Auxiliar de Limpeza:

  1. Limpar e arrumar todo o local em seus mínimos detalhes: janelas, vidraças, banheiros, cozinhas, área de serviço, garagens e pátios.
  2. Limpar assoalhos e móveis, carpetes e tapetes.
  3. Atuar com limpeza de área externa e interna, lavagem de vidros.
  4. Abastecer os ambientes com materiais e retirar lixo.
  5. Realizar limpeza no escritório, banheiros, vestiários e persianas.
  6. Varrer a fábrica ou empresa.
  7. Realizar a reposição de material de higiene e bebedouro.
  8. Manter rotinas de higiene e limpeza.

Em geral, o Auxiliar de Limpeza irá trabalhar em prol da organização e higienização dos ambientes da instituição.

Join to apply for the Senior DevOps Engineer role at Rain .

About Rain

Rain is the fastest-growing earned wage access (EWA) fintech in the U.S., serving 2.5 million employees and backed by top investors like QED and Prosus. We have raised nearly $400M, including the largest Series A in fintech history, and recently closed our Series B to support our hypergrowth.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Desire to improve business performance through discovery analysis.

title: Operador (a) de centrífuga de açúcar
description:
Job description

Operar conjunto de centrífugas automáticas e contínuas de açúcar observando seu funcionamento, acompanhar processos estabelecidos e verificar e executar manutenção, e limpeza delas.


Main responsibilities

· Operar centrifugas de massa "a" e massa "b" no setor da fábrica de açúcar, observando as características da massa de açúcar visualmente, acompanhando os resultados das análises do laboratório, programando os equipamentos (centrífugas) dentro das especificações de temperatura e pressão da agua de lavagem de tela e do açúcar , quantidade de massa adicionada a cada carga , tempo de centrifugação, tempo de lavagem inclusa no processo, acompanhando as etapas para que as especificações e a qualidade do açúcar e do mel mantenham o padrão exigido.

· Acompanhar o processo de lavagem de açúcar, observando o funcionamento dos bicos de lavagem e a temperatura e pressão da água utilizada, manipulando válvulas de vapor e efetuando paradas quando necessário, manualmente ou por meio de instrumentos, além de executar a limpeza e desobstrução dos mesmos para dar andamento no processo.

· Acompanhar o funcionamento das centrifugas, telas internas, sensores eletrônicos de controle do processo, observando o desgaste e solicitando

manutenção sempre que necessário

· Acompanhar o processo de centrifugação de açúcar, verificar os níveis dos cristalizadores, observar o funcionamento de bombas de magma e méis, verificando as condições ideais para sua operação e evitando paradas não programadas.

· Efetuar a limpeza de máquinas, equipamentos e piso do ambiente de trabalho para que as condições de higienização e segurança sejam mantidas.

· Utilizar os epi's determinados para a função e área de atuação.

· Auxiliar equipes de manutenção industrial no período de entressafra sob coordenação e orientação de profissionais técnicos ou de superior imediato do setor, em trabalhos de manutenção mecânica, como reparador de válvulas em geral, ajudante geral, ajudante de encanador, pintor, encanador ou soldador, limpeza necessárias.


Requirements and skills

Experiência (na área): 2 anos

Formação acadêmica: Ensino médio completo

Conhecimentos específicos: operação de centrifugas de açúcar automáticas e contínuas

Conhecimentos desejáveis: básico em caldeiraria, solda ou manutenção de válvulas.

About The Company

Se para você a tecnologia existe para melhorar o caminho da vida, para o nosso time também: Seu Caminho, Nossa Jornada.
Acreditamos na tecnologia que conecta gente boa no que faz e que vive a diversidade para criar e compartilhar até os caminhos que a gente (ainda!) nem sabe quais são. Trabalhamos para gerar valor não só para os nossos usuários, mas, sobretudo, para as comunidades que servimos e toda a sociedade, tornando a vida das pessoas melhor com serviços que facilitem seu dia a dia - seja com serviços de mobilidade e entrega (99) ou pagamentos digitais (99Pay).

Para facilitar a vida de milhões de pessoas todos os dias, desde 2018 fazemos parte da DiDi Global Inc., a maior plataforma de tecnologia e transporte por aplicativo do mundo. Somos pioneiros na criação de soluções inovadoras que começam no Brasil e que ganham escala para gerar impacto positivo em mais de 12 países em que a DiDi está presente. Essas inovações passam por sustentabilidade, segurança, inteligência artificial, mercado financeiro e um tanto mais.

Seja para construir projetos do zero ou aprimorar nossas soluções, gostamos de desafios que nos fazem sentir frio na barriga, e é por isso que trabalhamos num ritmo acelerado, com respeito, colaboração e bom humor. Nessa jornada, também nos fortalecemos nas diferentes vivências e opiniões para crescermos juntos, errar rápido, aprender e ajustar o caminho para criar soluções que tragam ainda melhores resultados.

About The Team/role

A principal função da nossa equipe de vendas é desenvolver e expandir nosso portfólio de contas, garantindo que eles tenham um bom desempenho na plataforma 99.

Através de um excelente atendimento ao cliente e de uma abordagem consultiva, o executivo de vendas deve estabelecer e manter relacionamentos comerciais bem-sucedidos e de longo prazo.

In this role, you'll be...

  • O principal ponto de contato para nossos parceiros, garantindo uma comunicação próxima e contínua para gerar insights estratégicos, atender às suas necessidades e desenvolver planos de ação para crescimento e uma experiência aprimorada do usuário.
  • Analisando dados e desenvolvendo uma compreensão profunda da dinâmica do mercado e do comportamento dos parceiros para projetar, planejar e implementar estratégias comerciais destinadas a aumentar as vendas.
  • Construindo e promovendo relacionamentos de longo prazo baseados na confiança, com uma mentalidade ganha-ganha para garantir parcerias sustentáveis e mutuamente benéficas.

We're eager to be in touch because you have...

  • Graduação em Administração de Empresas, Marketing, Relações Internacionais, ou áreas relacionadas.
  • 2+ anos de experiência em gestão de contas e vendas consultivas (a senioridade será avaliada ao longo do processo seletivo).
  • Capacidade e flexibilidade para se adaptar e aprender enquanto trabalha em um ambiente de startup em ritmo acelerado, com mudanças constantes e metas desafiadoras.
  • Habilidades interpessoais: habilidades de comunicação verbal e escrita, com capacidade de persuadir e manter relações de trabalho construtivas, assertivas, colaborativas e cooperativas com clientes internos e externos em organizações multinacionais.
  • Habilidades analíticas: capacidade de diagnosticar, compreender tendências de mercado e implementar planos de ação.
  • Senso de urgência e motivação para atingir objetivos enquanto analisa possíveis cenários.
  • Experiência em atingir e superar metas de vendas.
  • Conhecimento intermediário de Excel é um diferencial.

You'll love working at DiDi because...

We create user value

We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant and efficient.

We are data-driven

We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data-driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.

Win-win Collaboration

Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.

We believe in integrity

Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.

Growth

We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.

Diversity and Inclusion

Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what make us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.

Diversity & Inclusion

Diversity is not a vision of the future or something we wish to have one day, it is a non-negotiable value of who we are.

We practice inclusion, plurality, and respect. And we count on the governance of the Diversity Committee, which works together with HR, leadership and identity groups - 99Adapta, 99Afro, 99Cores, 99Mulheres, and 99Mamães. This part of our journey has been written, there remains a long road before us.

We reinforce that this position is open to everyone, including pregnant people and people with disabilities (PwD).

Você será responsável por garantir o funcionamento e a eficiência da infraestrutura de TI em nossas unidades e empreendimentos, atuando de forma técnica, operacional e estratégica.

  • Atuar no planejamento e implantação de infraestrutura de TI em stands de vendas e obras durante todo o ciclo de vida dos empreendimentos da empresa.

Seu papel será entender profundamente as necessidades do(a) cliente e conectá-las às nossas soluções financeiras com muita empatia, conhecimento sobre o mercado e encantamento. QUER FAZER PARTE DESTA JORNADA COM A GENTE?
Responsabilidades e atribuições
Análise e Monitoramento de Indicadores

  • Acompanhar e analisar os principais KPIs do canal atacado, como: sell-in, sell-out, faturamento, margem bruta, giro de produto;
  • Implementar rotinas de monitoramento de desempenho por coleção e categoria, com foco em resultados sustentáveis e escaláveis;
  • Desenvolver e manter dashboards em Power BI, além de ferramentas analíticas que apoiem a área comercial e o time de produtos em decisões táticas e estratégicas;
  • Apoiar na padronização e automação de relatórios.

Planejamento e Gestão Comercial
  • Apoiar na definição de metas comerciais e previsões de venda (forecasts) por cliente, região e coleção, considerando análises históricas, identificando oportunidades de crescimento;
  • Gerenciar o calendário comercial do canal atacado, garantindo o alinhamento das principais datas — como envio de amostras, entrega de linebook, planejamento do showroom, datas de market week e deadlines de produção de coleção — com os times de Produto, Comercial, Logística, Visual Merchandising e Marketing;
  • Trabalhar em parceria com o time de produto e comercial para definir sortimentos estratégicos em cada coleção e garantir cobertura adequada por território;
  • Apoiar no planejamento da aposta de estoque de pronta-entrega;
  • Construir análises pós-showroom para consolidar aprendizados e identificar oportunidades de melhoria para os ciclos seguintes;
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com o time de operações para garantir a viabilidade de abastecimento dentro dos prazos e janelas comerciais;
  • Acompanhar a performance in-season e sinalizar oportunidades de reposição;
  • Criar relatórios e apresentações executivas para rituais semanais, mensais e trimestrais, trazendo insights acionáveis, oportunidades de negócio e direcionamentos claros para tomada de decisão;
  • Atuar em interface com as áreas Comercial, Produto, Logística, Marketing, Visual Merchandising e Financeiro para garantir sinergia e eficiência na execução dos planos de sell-in e sell-out.

Requisitos e qualificações
  • Formação em Administração, Economia, Engenharia de Produção ou áreas correlatas;
  • Inglês fluente (escrita e conversação);
  • Pensamento analítico apurado, com foco em resultado;
  • Domínio de Power BI, Excel e PowerPoint (nível avançado);
  • Organização, atenção aos detalhes e boa gestão do tempo.

title: Conasa - Analista de Compliance Jr
description:
Criada em 2007, a Conasa Infraestrutura constitui-se como uma holding administradora de Sociedades de Propósito Específico (SPE), voltada inicialmente para serviços de saneamento. A Conasa ampliou sua área de atuação e hoje é uma plataforma de investimento em concessões de infraestrutura de médio porte, com ativos operacionais desde 2004 no segmento de saneamento; desde 2014 em iluminação pública; e, em 2018, ampliou para o segmento de rodovias, consolidando investimentos na expansão da infraestrutura de serviços essenciais no Brasil.

Com sede em Londrina/PR, a Conasa Infraestrutura está presente nas 5 regiões do Brasil, em 9 estados, através de 25 empresas investidas, gerando mais de 2300 empregos diretos.

A missão da empresa é prestar serviços em setores de infraestrutura, como saneamento, energia e rodovias, de forma sustentável, com elevada qualidade e respeito ao meio ambiente, gerando valor para usuários, investidores, colaboradores e parceiros.

A visão é ser reconhecida como uma empresa de excelência no setor privado, nas áreas em que atua.

Se identificou com a nossa história? Venha fazer parte do nosso time!

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  1. Apoiar o mapeamento de riscos de compliance em projetos e contratos (inclusive contratos públicos e PPPs).
  2. Auxiliar na análise de aderência de processos às normas legais, contratuais e regulatórias.
  3. Apoiar o monitoramento de obrigações da Lei Anticorrupção, Nova Lei de Licitações, LGPD, normas ambientais e de SST.
  4. Auxiliar na due diligence de fornecedores e terceiros.
  5. Contribuir com a revisão e implementação de políticas internas de integridade.
  6. Apoiar auditorias, fiscalizações e processos de certificação.
  7. Dar suporte na gestão de denúncias e investigações internas.
  8. Participar de treinamentos e campanhas de integridade e compliance.
  9. Controlar registros e documentações em sistemas internos.

Requisitos e qualificações

  1. Formação completa ou cursando: Administração, Direito, Engenharia, Ciências Contábeis, Relações Internacionais ou áreas correlatas.
  2. Cursos de extensão em Compliance, Governança, Controles Internos ou Anticorrupção (Desejável).
  3. Conhecimento básico sobre leis como: Lei Anticorrupção (12.846/13), Nova Lei de Licitações (14.133/21), LGPD, normas da CGU e TCU (Desejável).
  4. Conhecimento de ESG, especialmente aspectos ambientais e de governança, é um diferencial (Desejável).
  5. Inglês intermediário (Desejável).
  6. Pacote Office (Excel, PowerPoint e Word) – intermediário.
  7. Conhecimento em Power BI, SAP ou ferramentas de gestão de Compliance (Desejável).

  • Vale Alimentação – R$200,00.

  • Seguro Saúde (sem coparticipação).
  • Seguro de Vida.
  • Vale Transporte (sem desconto).

title: Tax Compliance Manager
description:
Domaine Finance

Type de contrat CDI

Expérience Minimum 10 ans

Responsibilities:

  1. TEP BR was selected for Large Taxpayers Group under “Special Tax & Economic Monitoring”.
  2. Manage a fiscal environment that is heavy, complicated, and unstable (Expectation for a Brazilian Tax Reform on Income Taxes, Pillar 2, New Transfer Pricing Rules, Implementation of the Tax Reform on Consumption Taxes).
  3. Update ERP (new version of transactions and reports that are key for tax calculation and tax compliance).
  4. TEPBR is Operator on both Exploration and Production assets.
  5. Ensure and develop a team composed of 2 direct reports (2 Tax Coordinators) + 10 indirect reports (tax assistants, being 4 TTE staff and 6 TAS).
  6. Perform 3 SOX controls.

Support the Tax Manager in the following activities:

  1. Define the criteria used to determine the CIT/PIS/COFINS/ICMS/ISS/SPT/Royalties payments.
  2. Perform studies in view of implementing tax optimizations.
  3. Define the criteria used to identify, monitor, and compensate the tax credits.
  4. Define how to properly respond to tax inspections and audits.
  5. Define the criteria used to fulfil the tax books, files and reports delivered to the Tax Administration (Federal, State and Municipal sphere), in accordance with Brazilian legislations.
  6. Establish procedures and internal controls for tax routines and ensure that they are in accordance with SOX, audits, antifraud and anti-corruption guidelines.
  7. Provide support to Finance departments (Accounting; Treasury; B&P; etc) of TTE BR on tax matters.
  8. Ensure that the Transfer Pricing demonstration meets the local tax requirements and defense files are kept in good order.
  9. Provide support on tax matters for Budget preparation and LTP exercise.
  10. Ensure the correctness of inventories for tax purposes.
  11. Stay updated with the tax legislation and jurisprudence and cascade the relevant information to all concerned Stakeholders.
  12. Assist Customs/Freight Forward activities to ensure compliance with the tax legislation.
  13. Support the SAP and Mastersaf implementation/alterations.
  14. Act as focal point for the implementation of the Tax Reform.

Accountabilities:

  1. Coordinate the team's activities to provide the correct information and reports within the deadlines to all stakeholders, notably Finance (Quarterly Closings, PDCs, and other financial events).
  2. Act as a Manager as Coach: Coordinate, supervise and mentor/coach tax coordinators, optimizing work allocation, creating a positive work environment, and contributing to staff performance through regular feedback.
  3. Ensure that the tax team is updated with changes in tax legislation and relevant jurisprudence.
  4. Ensure compliance with Company’s internal policies and procedures.
  5. Ensure that Tax payments are done correctly and on time, avoiding penalties and interests.
  6. Inform concerned stakeholders of the impacts caused by changes in tax legislation.
  7. Assist internal and external stakeholders in all matters regarding corporate taxes and indirect taxes.
  8. Assess opportunities to minimize the tax burden of the company.
  9. Liaise with the Litigation team to ensure that the report of tax risks is accurate and complete.

Qualifications:

  1. University degree in Accounting and Law.
  2. At least 10 years’ experience in Tax Department (prior experience in a Big-4 firm would be a differential).
  3. Strong experience in the Oil & Gas Business.
  4. Advanced English proficiency.
  5. Ability to work under pressure and with sharp deadlines.
  6. Managerial and business skills.
  7. High autonomy.

title: Devops
description:
Sobre a Techlead

Na Techlead, impulsionamos avanços digitais em nossos clientes unindo o poder da inteligência artificial e cibersegurança à precisão da engenharia de software para construir soluções únicas cada vez mais inovadoras e prontas para o ambiente corporativo. Mais que acelerar o crescimento dos negócios , com apoio de tecnologia de ponta, maximizamos a eficiência operacional. Estamos expandindo nosso time de engenharia de software e buscamos um(a) Analista de Configuração Pleno (DEVOPS) , que seja proativo(a) e esteja alinhado à nossa cultura de agilidade, colaboração, alta performance e eficiência.

Sua missão

Você fará parte do nosso time de infraestrutura, contribuindo com sua visão e habilidades na construção de soluções que resolvam problemas reais de grandes clientes, participando de projetos que causarão impactos positivos à sociedade. Suas principais responsabilidades incluirão:

  • Automatização de Processos: Desenvolve e implementa ferramentas e scripts para automatizar tarefas repetitivas, como integração contínua, entrega contínua e testes. Isso ajuda a reduzir erros humanos e acelerar o processo de desenvolvimento.
  • Integração Contínua e Entrega Contínua (CI/CD): Configura e gerencia pipelines de CI/CD para garantir que o código seja continuamente integrado, testado e entregue de maneira rápida e confiável.
  • Gerenciamento de Configuração: Utiliza ferramentas de gerenciamento de configuração para garantir que a infraestrutura e os ambientes de desenvolvimento estejam consistentes e configurados corretamente.
  • Monitoramento e Observabilidade: Implementa e mantém sistemas de monitoramento para acompanhar o desempenho e a saúde das aplicações e da infraestrutura. Isso ajuda a identificar e resolver problemas proativamente.
  • Gerenciamento de Infraestrutura: Trabalha com infraestrutura como código (IaC) para provisionar e gerenciar recursos de maneira eficiente.
  • Colaboração e Comunicação: Facilita a colaboração entre as equipes de desenvolvimento e operações, promovendo práticas e uma cultura DevOps que favoreçam a comunicação e a colaboração entre essas equipes.
  • Segurança: Integra práticas de segurança desde o início do desenvolvimento (DevSecOps), garantindo que a segurança seja uma parte integral do ciclo de vida do software.
  • Resolução de Problemas: Diagnostica e resolve problemas de desempenho e falhas em ambientes de produção, muitas vezes trabalhando em conjunto com desenvolvedores e engenheiros de sistemas.
Quem buscamos

Para embarcar nesta jornada conosco, é necessário:

  • Formação Acadêmica: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas afins.
  • Experiência: Mínimo de 3 anos de experiência em funções relacionadas a DevOps ou áreas relacionadas.
  • Desejável: Certificação em Segurança da Informação (CompTIA Security+, CISSP), Certificação em Metodologias Ágeis (Scrum Master, PMI-ACP), Idiomas: Inglês intermediário.
  • Habilidades Técnicas: Deploys de Middleware em OpenShift, Segurança em Middleware e OpenShift, Certificações: AWS Certified DevOps Engineer - Professional, Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA), Docker Certified Associate (DCA), Azure DevOps Engineer Expert.
Sua atuação

We are tech transformation specialists, uniting human expertise with AI to create scalable tech solutions.

With over 6,500 CI&Ters around the world, we’ve built partnerships with more than 1,000 clients during our 30 years of history. Artificial Intelligence is our reality.

Here at CI&T Campinas we're excited to be expanding our team with the addition of several Data Developers to help deliver some innovative and complex solutions to one of our large financial clients in the UK.

Part of your role will also be setting the processes for data mining, modeling and production.

  4. Excelentes habilidades organizacionais, atenção aos detalhes e capacidade de gerenciar múltiplas tarefas simultaneamente.

title: Java Back-End Engineer Vitória, Espírito Santo - Tech and IT Operations - America - Engineering[...]
description:
WHO WE ARE

At Trustly, we’re on a mission to deliver a better way to pay and get paid. Consumers deserve a payment option that prioritizes financial responsibility, and merchants should have the independence to accept payments without unnecessary costs. This mission drives everything we do.

We’re revolutionizing the payments industry by making Pay by Bank the new standard at checkout, providing a smarter payment option to credit and debit cards. For merchants and consumers, this means the freedom to make and receive payments with greater security and ease.

Fueled by this purpose, we’ve grown into a global network connecting 9,000 merchants to 650 million consumers through 12,000 banks across 33 countries, processing over $58 billion annually. As the leader in Pay by Bank, we aim to redefine the payments experience by delivering exceptional products and unmatched value.

With regional offices in Vitória, Brazil and Silicon Valley, USA, and our global headquarters in Stockholm, Sweden, we are a diverse team that spans over 30 nationalities. Embracing a culture of innovation and collaboration, our 'work from anywhere' policy allows employees in Brazil, the U.S., and Canada to work remotely within their country of residence, enabling flexibility while staying connected to our global team.

At Trustly, we believe that inclusion and diversity are essential foundations for building a fair and equitable society. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, ancestry, color, national origin, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, or disability status. Our main goal is to provide a fair, welcoming, diverse environment with opportunities for all collaborators. The stages of our selection process take place online and without distinction of any kind.

Now is the perfect time to join us and help accomplish our mission. If you’re inspired by purpose, thrive in a fast-paced and entrepreneurial environment, and are ready to shape the future of payments, we’d love to hear from you!

About the team

We are a fintech, so technology is the most important part of our product! Product engineering teams are primarily responsible for keeping Trustly running and ensuring that we can continue to grow at an accelerated pace. We are the guardians of business rules and integrations with our partners. When we are not directly responsible for this, we provide an interface with the necessary information for other teams to do.


What you'll do:

  • Efficiently design tech solutions, discuss non-functional requirements, propose new tools or ways to achieve goals, create technical documentation and assess new solutions taking part of design for maintainability, develop metrics, alerts, and system dashboards using metric systems such as Prometheus, Kibana, Grafana and New Relic;
  • Efficiently provide trainings for newcomers and for operational teams, provide trainings to technical and functional teams;
  • Autonomy to monitor system modules health and performance, to support Operational teams (MTS, banking, etc), to fix issues including PROD database changes;
  • Lead initiatives that involve support PM gather business requirements, take part in functional discussions with the Product Team, be capable to defend your ideas and proposals, document Features;
  • Lead initiatives that involve to head technical refinements, create plans for task-forces;
  • Autonomously develop complex solutions and lead initiatives that involve bugfixing, create and maintain integration tests, create and maintain unit tests, create API endpoints, create new backend services, entities, repositories, etc., estimate efforts and Investigate issues, develop UI for Admin Portal, update API endpoints, create and update SQL queries;
  • Autonomously analyze huge volumes of data and logs, take part in complex issue investigations and to recognize if the system is performing as expected.

Who you are:

  • Solid knowledge and experience with Java;
  • Solid knowledge of software engineering concepts;
  • Solid knowledge of relational and/or non-relational databases;
  • Basic knowledge of HTML, CSS, and Javascript;
  • Have ownership and focus on solutions;
  • Ability to work with remote and international teams;
  • Ability to communicate clearly and objectively;
  • Advanced English - you do need to feel comfortable participating in a meeting.

Our perks and benefits:

  • Bradesco health and dental plan, for you and your dependents, with no co-payment cost;
  • Life insurance with differentiated coverage;
  • Meal voucher and supermarket voucher;
  • Home Office Allowance;
  • Wellhub - Platform that gives access to spaces for physical activities and online classes;
  • Trustly Club - Discount at educational institutions and partner stores;
  • English Program - Online group classes with a private teacher;
  • Extended maternity and paternity leave;
  • Birthday Off;
  • Flexible hours/Home Office - our culture is remote-first! You can work in every city in Brazil;
  • Welcome Kit - We work with Apple equipment (Macbook Pro, iPhone) and we send many more treats! Spoiler alert: Equipment can be purchased by you according to internal criteria!;
  • Annual premium - As a member of our team, you are eligible to receive an annual bonus, at the company's discretion, based on the achievement of our KPIs and individual performance;
  • Referral Program - If you refer a candidate and we hire the person, you will receive a reward for that!

description:
Job description

FAÇA PARTE DA EMPRESA QUE TEM O MAIOR E MAIS INTEGRADO PORTFÓLIO LOGÍSTICO DO PAÍS!

Olá, somos a JSL, uma empresa brasileira que tem como missão oferecer serviços e soluções em logística. Nós planejamos, executamos e gerenciamos de forma eficiente, desde a movimentação e o armazenamento de produtos, nos clientes ou em nossas filiais, até o transporte.

Aqui, zelamos pela simplicidade, valorizamos o ser humano e acreditamos no que fazemos.

Buscamos gente que se identifique com os nossos princípios e valores, que seja comprometida com a satisfação dos nossos clientes, que inovam, gostam de aprender e queiram evoluir aqui.

Todos os processos seletivos conduzidos pela JSL são afirmativos, inclusivos e não discriminatórios.



Main responsibilities

  • Suporte na extração e qualificação de dados, desenvolvimento de dashboards e análise de relatórios;

  • Auxiliar na entrega regular de relatórios para suportar as reuniões de diretoria;
  • Executar melhorias nos dashboards e relatórios existentes;
  • Acompanhar o resultado do negócio, análise e controle de CAPEX;
  • Atuar em conjunto com as diversas áreas da empresa para entender eventuais diferenças na análise;
  • Elaborar relatórios com informações sob demanda;
  • Contribuir com estudos e provocações sobre os negócios e performance financeira;
  • Consolidação e análise de informações de empresas subsidiárias.


Requirements and skills

  • Graduação nos cursos de Administração, Comércio Exterior, Contabilidade, Economia, Engenharia ou cursos correlatos;
  • Experiência em Finanças e/ou Controladoria;
  • Capacidade de interpretar e comunicar insights e resultados de análises de forma clara e concisa;
  • Habilidade na resolução de problemas, pensamento analítico e atenção aos detalhes;

Os benefícios tradicionais que você já conhece, nós também temos. Queremos te mostrar que vamos além:

  • Licença Maternidade e Paternidade estendidas, além de um Kit nascimento para recém-mamães e recém-papais.

  • Cantinho da Mamãe: O espaço, na Matriz no Itaim Bibi e Sede Administrativa em Mogi das Cruzes, é dedicado às mamães que retornam de licença maternidade e querem seguir com o aleitamento materno. No local, há todos os itens para retirar e armazenar o leite, com privacidade e conforto.

Join Novibet as a Senior DevOps Engineer at our Brazilian HQ in São Paulo !

Are you ready to take on a key role in a dynamic, fast-growing company? If you have a passion for DevOps Engineering and thrive in a fast-paced environment, this could be the right opportunity for you.

Who We Are

Founded in 2010, Novibet is a leading GameTech company with a strong international presence. We operate in diverse markets, including Greece, Cyprus, Ireland, Canada, Brazil, Mexico, Chile, Ecuador, Finland, Italy, and New Zealand. With offices in Greece, Malta and Brazil, our mission is to deliver unparalleled sports betting and online gaming experiences to our rapidly expanding customer base.

Why Novibet

At Novibet, we are proud to be certified as a Great Place to Work, consecutively from 2021, reflecting our commitment to developing a positive, inclusive, and supportive work environment. Join us, and you will be part of a team of over 1,000 people worldwide that values collaboration, innovation, and personal growth.

What We are looking for

We are looking for a highly motivated Senior DevOps Engineer with a passion for automation, continuous integration, and cloud infrastructure. If you enjoy problem-solving, you are detail-oriented and have a mindset of continuous learning and improvement and are passionate about driving innovation through DevOps best practices, we’d love to hear from you!

What you will work on

  • Plan, build and maintain our infrastructure and always be on a constant lookout to improve our environment
  • Work closely with developers to create and improve deployment strategies and pipelines
  • Closely monitor our existing infrastructure and act if any abnormalities are found
  • Create and maintain documentation of our internal systems
  • Develop and maintain solutions for operational administration, system/data backup, disaster recovery, and security/performance monitoring
  • Deploy applications via automation with configuration management tools
  • Help define, document, evolve, and evangelize high engineering standards and best practices across multiple areas

What you bring

  • 3-5 years of experience in a DevOps or related role
  • Advanced expertise in Microsoft and Linux server administration
  • Proficient in version control using Git and GitFlow development models
  • Hands-on experience with configuration management and orchestration tools (e.g., Ansible, Chef, Salt, Puppet)
  • Skilled in building, administering, and managing CI/CD pipelines using tools such as TeamCity or Jenkins
  • Strong experience with cloud infrastructure on platforms like Azure, AWS, or GCP
  • Solid understanding of database technologies (e.g., MongoDB, PostgreSQL, MySQL)
  • Proficient in infrastructure-as-code using Terraform
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure monitoring tools (e.g., Grafana, Prometheus)
  • In-depth knowledge of containerization technologies (e.g., Kubernetes, AKS, Docker, OpenShift)
  • In-depth knowledge of kubernetes technologies (Helm, ArgoCD, AKS, Trafeik)
  • Strong networking fundamentals
  • Experience working with virtualized environments
  • Proficient in at least one scripting language (e.g., BASH, Python, PHP, Go)
  • Experience with log management and monitoring tools (e.g., ELK Stack, Splunk)
  • Experience with developing github actions
  • Familiarity with deployment strategies and tools (e.g., Ansible, Github Actions, ArgoCD, Octopus Deploy)
  • Knowledge of message queueing systems (e.g., RabbitMQ, ActiveMQ)
  • Understanding of in-memory data storage systems (e.g., Redis, Memcached)
  • Knowledge of web server and load balancer technologies (e.g., NginX, HAProxy)
  • Professional proficiency in English, verbal and written

What we offer

We truly value our people at Novibet! Within our vibrant, dynamic, and fast-paced environment, we encourage everyone to reach their full potential while enjoying every step of the journey. Here’s how we make that happen:

title: Carbon Markets Policy Specialist
description:
We are looking for a Carbon Markets Policy Specialist to join our Carbon Markets Policy & Guidance team. The team tracks organizations and governments seeking to shape private sector responses to climate change and the development of the carbon credit market on the path to net zero. This vacancy is for an experienced researcher to join our team and take the lead on carbon market policy research in Latin America.

About the role:

This role will take a leading role on the continued development of MSCI Carbon Markets policy analysis, with a particular focus on the Latin America region. The Carbon Markets Policy Specialist will also be involved in collating qualitative and quantitative data to track organizations, investors and governments seeking to shape corporate responses to climate change and the use of carbon credits.

Key to success in this role will be the ability to generate concise insights from disparate sources of information, covering emerging or fast-moving policy areas and complex standards, reports, and regulations.

The role will be based in São Paulo, Brazil.

Responsibilities will include:

  1. Analysis of national and subnational climate and carbon market policy in a range of countries, including conducting interviews and preparing country profiles.
  2. Tracking developments in international policy and standards relating to climate change, net zero and the voluntary carbon market.
  3. Qualitative and quantitative research across the policy areas covered by the team.
  4. Thought leadership on carbon markets and climate policy, with a focus on Latin America.
  5. Supporting MSCI’s COP30 strategy and policy engagement in the region.
  6. Communicating insights internally and externally, delivered to clients through client meetings and conferences, plus monthly reporting, an online platform, webinars and other research projects.

Successful candidates will have research, advisory or public policy experience relating to climate policy, carbon markets, or corporate climate strategies. This may have been gained through experience with research firms, governments, consultancy, corporate or investor sustainability teams, project developers, think tanks, NGOs, or academia.

Candidates should have a strong team ethic, excellent written communications skills, and be capable of extracting insights and communicating them with clarity to senior-level audiences.

Qualifications and experience:

  1. Degree in Environmental Studies, Climate Change, Public Policy, or a related field. Post-graduate degree preferred.
  2. At least 5 years’ experience from the public, private, financial or NGO sectors relating to climate change, net zero, or carbon markets.
  3. Experience with national climate policy or international climate negotiations is particularly welcomed.
  4. Excellent communication skills in English and Portuguese. Communication skills in Spanish would be a distinct asset for this role.
  5. Proven responsibility for delivering reports, briefings, or other written outputs.
  6. Presentation skills to clearly articulate ideas and facilitate strong relations with a global team of carbon and climate research analysts, technology and operations teams.
  7. Knowledge across various climate policy issues, with the ability to extract insights and communicate complex issues to senior-level audiences.
  8. Demonstrable enthusiasm for addressing climate change in the corporate and financial sectors.

This role is for you if you are:

  1. Aware of what a corresponding adjustment is and actively interested in Article 6 debates.
  2. Inquisitive, analytical, and naturally inclined to ask, ‘But what does this mean?’, ‘So what?’ and ‘What happens next?’
  3. Comfortable both writing a 20-page report and summarizing a new policy development in a sentence.
  4. Collaborate generously with your teammates but effective at working independently.
  5. Are passionate and pragmatic about how the world can tackle the climate challenge.

What we offer you:

  1. Transparent compensation schemes and comprehensive employee benefits, tailored to your location, ensuring your financial security, health, and overall wellbeing.
  2. Flexible working arrangements, advanced technology, and collaborative workspaces.
  3. A culture of high performance and innovation where we experiment with new ideas and take responsibility for achieving results.
  4. A global network of talented colleagues, who inspire, support, and share their expertise to innovate and deliver for our clients.
  5. Global Orientation program to kickstart your journey, followed by access to our platform, LinkedIn Learning Pro and tailored learning opportunities for ongoing skills development.
  6. Multi-directional career paths that offer professional growth and development through new challenges, internal mobility and expanded roles.
  7. We actively nurture an environment that builds a sense of inclusion belonging and connection, including eight Employee Resource Groups. All Abilities, Asian Support Network, Black Leadership Network, Climate Action Network, Hola! MSCI, Pride & Allies, Women in Tech, and Women’s Leadership Forum.

At MSCI we are passionate about what we do, and we are inspired by our purpose – to power better investment decisions. You’ll be part of an industry-leading network of creative, curious, and entrepreneurial pioneers. This is a space where you can challenge yourself, set new standards and perform beyond expectations for yourself, our clients, and our industry.

MSCI is a leading provider of critical decision support tools and services for the global investment community. With over 50 years of expertise in research, data, and technology, we power better investment decisions by enabling clients to understand and analyze key drivers of risk and return and confidently build more effective portfolios. We create industry-leading research-enhanced solutions that clients use to gain insight into and improve transparency across the investment process.

Within Google Cloud, the Small/Medium Businesses (SMB) Partnerships team is driving rapid Google Workspace and Google Cloud Platform (GCP) growth via our global partner network.

As a Strategic Partnerships Development Manager, you will drive Google Workspace and GCP sales for small/medium businesses across global markets by working collaboratively with our SMB partner lead, direct sales teams, and our extensive partner network. Partners are critical to the growth, adoption, and scale of Google Cloud products. You will work with key SMB-focused partners to develop their Google Cloud business via sales and marketing campaigns, training, and enablement. You will be the key point of contact for our top SMB partners, developing a deep understanding of partner growth drivers and identifying creative solutions to increase sales across various categories of Google Cloud partners. You are collaborative, creative, and able to drive sales at scale through our partner ecosystem. You have experience selling Cloud solutions or working with SaaS partners, and understanding how to measure and grow SMB business. You will manage the partner ecosystem, both directly and at scale, and partner with our direct sales team to build and execute growth initiatives.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

Technology Stack Management

  • Maintain and optimize the RevOps tech stack (e.g., HubSpot, Salesforce, Pandadoc ) to minimize disruptions across Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, and Support teams .

Testing & Deployment

  • Test changes in sandbox environments , deploy updates to production, and validate post-deployment functionality.

Project Ownership

  • Manage and maintain the RevOps Roadmap Jira board , ensuring priorities align with stakeholder feedback.
  • Lead weekly RevOps sprint planning sessions and provide actionable insights.
  • Oversee large-scale RevOps projects , such as implementing Pandadoc for order management .

Process Optimization & Documentation

  • Develop a deep understanding of lead flow processes and attribution models (e.g., why a lead is categorized as "Other" vs. another channel).
  • Document the RevOps tech stack , outlining each vendors purpose and function (e.g., in a spreadsheet or similar format).
  • Identify and implement opportunities for process improvements in revenue operations.

Qualifications

  • Proven experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or a related role , with hands-on expertise in HubSpot, Salesforce, and Pandadoc .
  • Strong technical aptitude , with the ability to troubleshoot bugs, manage integrations, and update software packages .
  • Exceptional attention to detail and experience with testing and deploying changes in a production environment.
  • Deep understanding of lead flow, attribution models, and CRM systems , with the ability to explain complex processes clearly.
  • Self-starter with a proactive mindset , able to work independently.
  • Familiarity with Jira or similar project management tools is a plus.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills to work effectively across Marketing, Sales, Success, and Support teams .
  • Experience creating detailed documentation or spreadsheets mapping tech stack components and their functions.
  • Passion for analyzing and optimizing lead flow processes to enhance revenue operations.

If you are an analytical, tech-savvy professional with a passion for revenue operations, we would love to hear from you!

title: Senior Analyst, Customer Operation
description:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build asustainableeconomy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactionssecure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title and Summary

Senior Analyst, Customer Operation osition Title: Senior Analyst, Customer Operations
Who is Mastercard?
Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships, and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.
Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all.
Overview
The Ethoca Customer Experience & Engagement team is looking for a Senior Analyst, Customer Operations to help drive our operational excellence and customer experience strategy forward. This customer-facing position plays a key role in supporting customer operations, contributing to process improvements, and driving initiatives that ensure Ethoca’s services are delivered according to our best-in-class standards.
Our ideal candidate is a problem-solver who takes initiative, feels comfortable making decisions, and contributes actively to cross-functional projects. You’ll be a bridge between customers and internal teams, with opportunities to lead initiatives that improve both customer outcomes and operational performance.
Role
Support live customers with account updates, escalations, and operational inquiries
Own and drive customer-facing and internal operational projects
Participate in process reviews and propose improvements
Act as a conduit between internal and external stakeholders, managing expectations and resolving competing priorities
Develop expertise on internal tools, support processes, and onboarding journeys
Act as the subject matter expert for Ethoca's customer-facing tools and services
Facilitate customer-facing refresher training sessions when needed
All About You
Strong English communication skills (written and verbal)
Comfortable interacting directly with customers and understanding their business needs
Capable of independently driving tasks and decisions while balancing cross-team collaboration
Experience supporting API/SFTP B2B technology solutions, ideally in fintech or SaaS environments
Analytical and detail-oriented, with a passion for solving problems and optimizing workflows
Have the flexibility to support international time zones for our global customer support
Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple priorities
Nice to Have
Intermediate Spanish proficiency
Experience with automation tools, RPA, or Microsoft Copilot
Familiarity with tools such as Postman, JIRA, Splunk, Azure, SQL
Prior knowledge in Fraud & Chargebacks or payment industry solutions
Encouraging Diverse Applications
At Mastercard, we are committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace. We encourage all candidates, especially women and individuals from underrepresented groups, to apply—even if they don’t meet every single requirement listed. Studies show that women are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet 100% of the criteria. We value potential and a growth mindset just as much as experience.

Corporate Security Responsibility


All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

  • Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;

  • Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;

  • Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and

  • Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

#vempramaqnelson

O Grupo Maqnelson possui 65 anos de mercado, com mais de 600 colaboradores, atuando em Minas Gerais, Goiás, Espírito Santo nos segmentos de Máquinas Agrícolas, Irrigação, Drones, Locação de máquinas e equipamentos, Empreendimentos e Corretora de Seguros.

Seguimos boas práticas de governança corporativa buscando resultados sustentáveis aos acionistas, clientes, fornecedores e para as comunidades que atuamos.

Somos uma das empresas pioneiras no fornecimento de soluções e tecnologias para elevação da produtividade da agricultura no Brasil. Venha fazer parte do nosso time!

  10. Contagem de estoque.

Requirements and skills
